comment: Eight parameters and eight inputs are declared with no widget: the camera yaw and pitch, both emitters' azimuth, elevation and heading, the navigation speed, and the four emitter velocity CV jacks. The camera pair are set by dragging the display and the emitter positions likewise; the velocity inputs the manual describes have no jack on this panel at all, so the modulation it suggests cannot be patched. No family is given to the first audio input: whatever is patched, audio or CV, is carried into the chamber. The tail length is sized from the crystal's own volume and surface area by Sabine's equation, so a larger habit really does ring longer.
